records.quote: Here, we report an ionogel with bipolar switchable thermopowers from +7.71 to -3.77 mV K-1 induced by a lower critical solution temperature phase behavior.

records.subject: Phase separation
records.quote: These thermoresponsive ionogels exhibit nonlinear thermal voltages once the phase separation occurs, which can be used for intelligent over-temperature protection sensors.

records.subject: Series integration of p–n pairs
records.object: Thermopiles with highly sensitive heat-flux detection
records.quote: Moreover, thermopiles with high-sensitive heat flux detection are prepared by integrating p-n pairs in series.
modality_evidence: Moreover, thermopiles with high-sensitive heat flux detection are prepared by integrating p-n pairs in series.

records.subject: Prototype wearable device integrating 24 p–n pairs
records.quote: A prototype wearable device integrated with 24 p-n pairs achieves a total thermopower of 0.22 V K-1 and a heat flux sensitivity of up to 2 V m W-1.

records.subject: Thermoresponsive ionogel
records.quote: These nonvolatile ionogels with bipolar switchable thermopower offer great prospects for applications such as intelligent thermal sensing.
